description: This file declares functions related to configuration management and environment variable handling for the tracing system, specifically emitting 'def_param' events for interesting configuration and environment variables, and managing internal resources.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_list_config_fl
methods.description: Iterates over all configuration settings, emitting 'def_param' events for interesting ones.

methods.name: tr2_list_env_vars_fl
methods.description: Iterates over environment variables, emitting 'def_param' events for interesting ones.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_set_fl
methods.description: Emits a 'def_param' event for a specific key/value pair if the key is considered interesting.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_free_patterns
methods.description: Frees memory related to configuration patterns.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_free_env_vars
methods.description: Frees memory related to environment variables.
